name: Spectrum
line: The evidence scale as light: a luminous band from deep red (Group 1) to pale grey (Group 3) opens the page with a slow light sweep, compresses as you scroll and docks as a slim scale on the left edge (top edge on smaller screens) whose marker follows the group each section is about; the cancer explorer is drawn from its real data as rays falling from a spectrum of exposures.
notes: Colour appears only as the scale: the band, the docked scale, the group swatches and the exposure colours in the cancer drawing (Group 1, 2A, 2B). The cancer drawing is an inline SVG generated from media/graph.json (exposures ordered by group along the top, the 469 links falling to the 68 cancer types; dashed = suspected). The chronic network stays in greyscale because its grades are not IARC groups. The dock is an enhancement and is absent without JavaScript. Funnel Display and Funnel Sans are Latin-only.
